extracted.stage: Financial provision action proceeding to proof at the Court of Session
extracted.summary: An Edinburgh solicitor asks whether funding of £35,000 is available for a client pursuing a financial provision action at the Court of Session, where matrimonial property is around £350,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the clear summary of the matter. We have noted the £35,000 sought, matrimonial property of around £350,000, and that the action is proceeding to proof at the Court of Session. So that we can review this properly, we would be grateful for confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the proceedings are raised, any key hearing or proof dates, details of the assets proposed as security and any existing charges over them, and your client's details for identity checks. A colleague will come back to you once the enquiry has been reviewed.
